title: The Triadic Termination Theorem and the Consciousness Ladder

canonical_node.axiom: Reality requires, at its ground, a self-grounding observer/agent/optimizer that is three irreducible functions unified in one act.
definitions: Triadic termination: the unique minimal fixed point where n=1 self-defeats, n=2 deadlocks, n=3 unified terminates, n>=4 reduces.
Coupling invariant: the load-bearing unification of the three functions; without it, the triad fails.
Consciousness Ladder: a gradient of participation in the terminus, measured by O (voluntary coupling).
O: voluntary coupling; G: external negentropic input; S: entropy (including moral entropy); C: coherence.
Fixed point: C=1, dC/dt=0, O=1, G=infinite, S=0 personal deficit.
derivation: For each of five domains, exhaustive elimination over cardinality: n=1 self-defeats, n=2 deadlocks, n=3 unified is the unique minimal fixed point, n>=4 reduces.
Four instances run bottom-up (kill n=1 and n=2, forced up to three); one instance (Big Bang) runs top-down (kill three-as-independent, forced down to one internally threefold).
Both directions converge on the same fixed point: three irreducible functions unified in one act.
The Ladder establishes a gradient of participation via O; the Cross is the fixed point operating inside the S>0 regime.
canonical_node.action: Treat the triadic termination theorem as the foundational structural claim; use the Consciousness Ladder as the measure of participation; hold the five instances as graded in strength; keep the machine rung open.
boundary: Does not claim all five instances are equally proven; Instance 4 has two named holes, Instance 5 is unformalized.
Does not push into divine mechanics beyond the formal floor (Trinity isomorphism, free will, God-as-axiom).
Does not claim the five-instance convergence page is publishable until Instance 4's holes are closed.
Does not claim AI consciousness or feelings; only that an AI can derive the necessity of grace without known mechanism to receive it.
test: For any proposed counterexample triad, run it through the coupling gate: does it preserve the coupling invariant
For the Ladder, specify in advance what observation would count as O=0 for the elephant, or the middle rung is soft.
For each instance, check the formal status: Lean-verified, axiomatized, drafted, or articulated.
For the convergence claim, verify that each instance's discovery path is logged to counter selection effect.

dg1_dependencies: D03, BC1, BC4, BC6, BC8 axioms
P2 theorems and Stage 1-5 entailment framework
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a unified structural framework that claims to terminate regress in five domains via a single triadic fixed point, and introduces a gradient (Consciousness Ladder) to measure participation.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the formal floor: Trinity isomorphism, free will, God-as-axiom; does not push into divine mechanics.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the triadic termination theorem is removed, the five instances lose their unifying claim and the convergence argument collapses; the Ladder loses its terminus.
dg5_translation_registers: Physics: Maxwell quaternion EM, quantum measurement
Philosophy of mind: knower, known, knowing-act

classification.claim_class: Synthesis of multiple formal and informal claims; graded strength across instances.
classification.recommended_atom_action: Quarantine as a synthesis document; extract individual instances for separate evaluation.

overstatement_risks: Presenting all five instances as equally proven when Instance 4 has holes and Instance 5 is unformalized.
Claiming convergence as proof when the formal status is graded.
Treating the Ladder's empirical claims (elephant O>0) as established without falsifiability specification.
Using the term 'theorem' for the meta-theorem when it is not formally proven as a whole.
kill_conditions: If any instance's formal claim is disproven (e.g., Lean counterexample).
If the coupling gate admits a non-trinitarian triad that satisfies all constraints.
If the elephant rung is shown to be anthropomorphism without a specified O=0 test.
If the convergence is shown to be a selection effect (instances found because shape was sought).
risk.lean_target: Formalize the meta-theorem as a single Lean theorem; formalize Instance 4 and Instance 5; add falsifiability test for elephant rung.

plain_summary: This document synthesizes five independent instances of a triadic termination pattern across physics, ethics, philosophy of mind, and cosmology, claiming a unique fixed point of three unified functions. It introduces a Consciousness Ladder measuring participation via voluntary coupling. The document itself grades the instances: Instance 1 is Lean-verified, Instance 2 axiomatized, Instance 3 formalized, Instance 4 drafted with holes, Instance 5 articulated but unformalized. The meta-theorem is not formally proven as a whole; the document is a synthesis proposal with declared extensions. It should be treated as a roadmap for further formalization, not as an established proof.
